core_delta: Integrate ClayGraph as a derived associative projection inside M.MEMORY_FABRIC, backed by exact anchors from M.DURABLE_EVENT_STATE/current stores. Do not replace S.COGNITIVE_FRAME, M.CAPABILITY_GATEWAY/K0, or latency-critical exact reflex state with associative graph truth.

proposed_state_contract.invariant: Every model-visible graph memory item is provenance/path explainable; current/authority-sensitive propositions require exact-anchor validation; conflicts are preserved rather than averaged.

proposed_module_deltas.change: Add ClayGraph semantic projector/query assembler and exact-anchor resolver; retain direct-store fallback.
Expose revisioned read-only projection/changefeed/outbox contract for graph builder where safe.
Pass frame id/revision witnesses/freshness scope into assembly queries; graph cannot validate its own frame.
proposed_module_deltas.effect: Prevents semantic activation from overriding causal consistency.

proposed_module_deltas.change: Memory channel may consume validated S.ACTIVE_ASSEMBLY candidates; workspace selection/ignition remains separate.
proposed_module_deltas.effect: Associative memory feeds GWT without conflating activation with ignition or truth.

proposed_module_deltas.change: May use graph relation/recurrence as proposal evidence only, with source/novelty refs.
proposed_module_deltas.effect: Supports testable goal revision without authority escalation.

proposed_module_deltas.change: No authority change; graph contains opaque capability refs/receipts only and never secrets.

cross_branch_effects.clay: REFINE adaptive semantic resolution into exact-anchor/semantic/activation three-layer substrate
cross_branch_effects.claycode: REFINE assertion envelope + exact witness contracts; no authority drift
cross_branch_effects.gwt: REFINE memory candidate source but preserve EVENT_WS receipts and ignition distinction
cross_branch_effects.hyperposition: SUPPORT three-topology separation and n-ary/conflict representation
cross_branch_effects.emergenz: NO_CLAIM_CHANGE; S.ACTIVE_ASSEMBLY becomes lesion/rescue testable candidate

required_next_frank_tests: EXP-FRANK-CLAYGRAPH-SHADOW-PARITY: legacy direct queries vs derived graph on exact/history/conflict/multi-hop workloads.
EXP-FRANK-CLAYGRAPH-FRAME-STALE: inject stale/conflicting graph relations against fresh CognitiveFrame and verify exact-anchor rejection/refresh.
EXP-FRANK-CLAYGRAPH-GWT-LESION: legacy memory vs graph assembly vs shuffled graph assembly at matched token budget.
EXP-FRANK-CLAYGRAPH-QWEN4B: matched-budget small-model task accuracy when target inference is available.
rollback: All proposed runtime integration is feature-gated; authoritative SQLite/event state remains readable and graph is rebuildable until per-store cutover evidence exists.
